info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Telecom Sim Portability-v1-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Portability API facilitates the seamless process of transferring a mobile number from one telecom provider to another. This API allows service providers and authorized entities to initiate simmer portability requests, ensuring a smooth migration experience for customers. Typical consumers include mobile network operators and third-party service integrators aiming to enhance customer services and streamline the porting process. By leveraging this API, telecom companies can efficiently manage and track portability requests, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

post.description: This operation allows users to submit a request for SIM portability. It ensures the smooth transition of the mobile number from one carrier to another, enabling users to keep their existing number while changing operators.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a portability operation for a SIM card. It should contain all the necessary information to process the portability request as defined in the schema.
